summary: Members of Council may file petitions.
decided: City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "I need your voice - reverse the funding cuts to Toronto Public Health," submitted by Councillor Brad Bradford, Ward 19, Beaches-East York, containing the names of approximately 188 persons. 2. Petition regarding the Provincial health cuts to Public Health, submitted by Councillor Joe Cressy, Ward 10, Spadina-Fort York, containing the names of approximately 8,967 persons.
text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "I need your voice - reverse the funding cuts to Toronto Public Health," submitted by Councillor Brad Bradford, Ward 19, Beaches-East York, containing the names of approximately 188 persons. 2. Petition regarding the Provincial health cuts to Public Health, submitted by Councillor Joe Cressy, Ward 10, Spadina-Fort York, containing the names of approximately 8,967 persons.
